Mallplaza Alameda

Large-format mall in the heart of Santiago Centro, on Alameda Bernardo O'Higgins. Excellent metro connectivity with a wide range of stores, dining and entertainment on the city's main axis.

Best for

  • Tourists in Santiago Centro
  • Access from anywhere by metro
  • Varied shopping

Not ideal for

  • Those looking for premium or quiet malls
  • Weekdays during rush hour

Getting there

Access from multiple Line 1, Line 2 and Line 3 stations.

Recommended time: 2–3 hours
